correctness.rationale: Complete 3^8-state face enumeration yields 944 simplices; 464 nonempty face-toggle Morse pairs and all 3440 directed Hasse covers are verified with an acyclic topological ordering, leaving one critical 0-simplex and fifteen 4-simplices. Signed Lefschetz traces for all 48 S2 x S4 automorphisms give class rows (15,-3,0,-1,1) and (3,1,0,-5,1), checked against explicit irreducible S4 character rows in standalone verify.py. No unproved extrapolation outside K2,4.

value.rationale: Full nonabelian S4 symmetry coupled with the central bipartition-exchange involution divides a known 15-dimensional degree-four homology into mathematically distinct 9- and 6-dimensional eigenspace modules and specifies all Specht multiplicities. These invariants distinguish graph actions invisible to the known wedge homotopy type; K2,4 is the smallest complete bipartite case with four-letter symmetric representation types and a nontrivial refined splitting.
